basis: Both preregistered shape-only candidates materially improve full-cell Y3 CRPS in all three frozen 2014-2020 chronology blocks; pooled two-way bootstrap intervals are above zero.

Both candidates materially improve pooled four-region Brier score in 2014-2020 and preserve D1 expected points/MAE exactly by construction, demonstrating value from distribution shape rather than a mean boost.

Neither candidate clears the preregistered p95+ tail-calibration gate: survivor probability moves farther from the observed productive-survivor mass and combined survivor/downside absolute calibration error does not improve.
Locked 2021-2022 preserves positive Y3 CRPS direction for both candidates, but four-region Brier uncertainty spans zero and p95+ tail calibration again worsens versus D1.
Y2 no-harm controls pass and expected means are unchanged, so the distributional research direction is credible even though the tested candidates are insufficient.
The previously failed D1H90 mean challenger remains only a reference; it is not rescued or retried.
classification: B. DISTRIBUTIONAL DIRECTION SUPPORTED, BUT NO CANDIDATE EARNS AUTHORITY
next_research_implication: Richer uncertainty remains justified, but a new candidate family would require a separate management directive. Do not iterate from holdout.
